tradeseeker.title: Trade Seeker
tradeseeker.need_world: Join a world to see the enchantments.
tradeseeker.autobuy.tip: On: buys the book the moment it's found (you need the emeralds and a book on you). Off: stops with the trade screen open so you decide.
tradeseeker.hint: Look at the villager, stand by its lectern, press Start. J stops.
tradeseeker.status.picked: %s picked · click a level to change it
tradeseeker.status.wait_jobless: Re-roll %s: waiting for the villager to lose its job…
tradeseeker.status.wait_job: Re-roll %s: waiting for the villager to take the lectern…
tradeseeker.status.wait_lectern: Waiting for the lectern to land in your inventory…
tradeseeker.msg.nothing_wanted: Pick at least one enchantment first (press J).
tradeseeker.msg.no_villager: No villager found. Look at the villager you want to re-roll and stand close to it.
tradeseeker.msg.nitwit: That's a nitwit (green coat). Nitwits never take a job.
tradeseeker.msg.no_lectern: No lectern in reach. Place one next to the villager and stand by it.
tradeseeker.msg.started: Re-rolling with the lectern at %s. Press J to stop.
tradeseeker.msg.too_far: You moved too far from the lectern, so it stopped.
tradeseeker.msg.too_far_villager: The villager is out of reach. Stand closer to it.
tradeseeker.msg.no_trades: The villager won't show its trades.
tradeseeker.msg.locked: Someone has traded with this librarian, so its trades are locked for good. Use one nobody has traded with.
tradeseeker.msg.max_rolls: Gave up after %s re-rolls (the limit you set).
tradeseeker.msg.your_call: It's selected in the trade screen. Take it from the result slot to buy it, or close the screen to leave it.
tradeseeker.msg.buy_closed: The trade screen closed before it could buy.
tradeseeker.msg.cant_afford: Couldn't buy it: you need the emeralds and a book on you. The trade is still there; the screen is open.
tradeseeker.msg.bought: Bought %s. The librarian's trades are now locked in.
tradeseeker.msg.kept_job: The villager kept its job. It may have traded before, or claimed another lectern nearby.
tradeseeker.msg.spot_taken: The lectern's spot is blocked, or there is nothing solid to place it against.
tradeseeker.msg.no_lectern_item: No lectern in your inventory. Stand right next to it so you pick it up, or carry a spare.
tradeseeker.msg.other_job: The villager took a different job. Remove other job blocks near it.
tradeseeker.msg.stolen: A jobless villager next door took the lectern. Give the neighbours a job first, or wall them off.
tradeseeker.msg.no_job: The villager didn't take the lectern in 60 seconds. It has to be able to walk to it, and villagers don't take jobs while asleep.
